title: UNEARTH
problem: Digital content is often impermanent, leading to the loss of personal histories. Existing platforms lack depth for meaningful storytelling, and privacy concerns persist. This project seeks to provide a dedicated platform for curating, preserving, and sharing memories, bridging generational gaps and encouraging reflection in an increasingly digital world.
overview: Unearth is a versatile and engaging product that combines elements of storytelling, history, and personal connection to create a unique and meaningful online experience. It allows users to curate their digital legacies and explore the stories of others, fostering a sense of connection across time and generations.
role: Conducted user research and usability testing to understand and validate users' pain points.
Designed platform assets from zero to one, using an agile process to iterate continuously.
Worked as the sole designer using Figma.
contribution: Research, Branding, Usability testing, UX/UI Design, Prototypes.

sections.title: The project

blocks.heading: The goal — Design an app that will:

list: Create an emotional connection between users and their memories, as well as the stories shared by others.
Maintain a consistent visual identity throughout the app to build trust and recognition.
Present stories, historical context, and privacy controls clearly so users can curate and share memories with confidence.

blocks: Unearth highlights the significance of creating a user-centered, accessible, and emotionally engaging platform that addresses users' diverse needs, fosters connections with the past, and offers both personal and educational value. The project demonstrates that with thoughtful design and continuous improvement, digital platforms can serve as powerful tools for preserving and sharing personal and historical narratives.

list: Inclusivity Matters: Accessibility should be a foundational consideration in platform design.
Emotional Connection: Design elements that foster emotional connections with memories and stories can be a powerful tool in engaging users and making the platform more meaningful.
Cross-Generational Appeal: Platforms that bridge generational gaps can attract a wide user base, encouraging intergenerational storytelling and connection.

sections.title: Understanding the user
blocks: I conducted user interviews with potential users of "Unearth: A Virtual Time Capsule Adventure." Many participants felt disconnected from their personal histories and uncertain about how to preserve and share their memories. The research showed a need for a platform that makes curating and exploring digital time capsules simple and approachable.

list: People lacked a clear structure for organizing memories, media, and historical context in one place.
Existing social platforms prioritize immediate sharing over long-term preservation and meaningful storytelling.
Users needed clearer privacy and audience controls before they felt comfortable sharing personal histories across generations.

blocks: Sarah's needs and preferences helped shape Unearth for people like her, providing a meaningful and accessible way to preserve and share personal histories and stories.

sections.title: Design Process
blocks: Iterating through paper drafts for each screen of the "Unearth the Past" platform ensured that the elements incorporated into the digital interface were thoughtfully designed to address user needs effectively. In the home screen design, priority was given to providing an intuitive display of the user's time capsule collection, while also encouraging users to explore and discover new features for preserving and sharing their personal histories and stories.

sections.title: Usability Testing
blocks: The usability testing revealed that Unearth was generally well-received by users. They appreciated its emotional impact, ease of use, and potential for both personal and educational purposes. The findings also highlighted opportunities for refinement, particularly in terms of simplification, accessibility, and additional features to further enhance user engagement and satisfaction.

list: Make sure that interactive elements have visible focus states, so users can see which element is currently selected or active.
Include captions for audio and video content, and provide transcripts for multimedia content to accommodate users with hearing impairments.
Implement clear and descriptive labels for form fields, provide error messages and suggestions for corrections, and ensure that forms are easy to complete using assistive technologies.
Continue refining accessibility features, ensuring that the platform is even more user-friendly for individuals with disabilities.
Conduct ongoing user testing to gather feedback from a diverse range of users.
Expand the educational resources available on the platform, including guides, tutorials, and lesson plans.
